title: Deadlock in GDScriptCache with preload()
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7-stable [5b4e0cb]



### System information

Godot v4.7.stable (5b4e0cb0f) - Manjaro Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sun, 24 May 2026 04:55:09 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX (RADV NAVI31) - AMD Ryzen 9 7950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 62.52 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

While using a threaded ResourceLoader, a worker thread gets stuck in GDScriptCache::get_full_script() at the snippet below (`gdscript_cache.cpp:392`)
```cpp
	// Allowing lifting the lock might cause a script to be reloaded multiple times,
	// which, as a last resort deadlock prevention strategy, is a good tradeoff.
	{
		uint32_t allowance_id = WorkerThreadPool::thread_enter_unlock_allowance_zone(singleton->mutex);
		r_error = script->reload(true); <-- This script->reload() get stuck
		WorkerThreadPool::thread_exit_unlock_allowance_zone(allowance_id);
	}
``` 
From the description in the comment, it seems that this should lift the lock, but the same thread gets stuck further down in another call to ResourceLoader::load() due to a preload() in the script in question.

This thread is trying to load Script A. Script A contains a preload("scene.tscn"). "scene.tscn" contains script B, which is currently in the process of being loaded by a different worker thread (which is calling `GDScriptCache::move_script()`), but can't make progress because the thread trying to load Script A is still holding the GDScriptCache mutex lock, so Script A stays stuck waiting for the "scene.tscn" to load, while a different thread is stuck waiting for the mutex to be released so it can finish loading script B.

I will admit I don't know enough about the engine internals here to know what `thread_enter_unlock_allowance_zone` actually enables, but it seems the mutex in question never gets unlocked.

Every other Worker thread is waiting on the shared GDScriptCache singleton mutex which is held by the thread above (in GDScriptCache::get_full_script). 


### Steps to reproduce

This doesn't happen every time - in fact, i can't reproduce it if i remove any other entirely unrelated scripts from the project (which are not preloaded or preload anything and are entirely not within the same dependency chain as the scripts in question). It looks to me like the deadlock happens because every available ResourceLoader worker thread is blocked waiting to load a different script, so none of them make progress on the preloaded resource. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Unfortunately the nature of the problem means I haven't been able to reproduce it in another project yet. Removing unrelated assets or scripts from the project I currently have makes the deadlock far rarer, so it's hard to create an MRP that doesn't include the entire rest of my current project, which isn't shareable.
